clue.text: Can't contract be used as proof against psychiatrists?

definitions.meaning: fabric that will not get smaller in the wash

definitions.text: be used as proof against psychiatrists?
definitions.meaning: playful reading: able to hold off shrinks, slang for psychiatrists

explanation.definitionFit: Clothing labelled this way keeps its size when washed; whimsically, it also means immune to therapists' probing.

clue.text: Frank is directly in front

definitions.meaning: candid, honest and plain-speaking
positioned dead ahead, literally straight and forward

explanation.definitionFit: A candid person is plain-dealing; split into its parts the phrase also describes a position dead ahead.

clue.text: Splendid but empty words about reciprocal aid

indicators.note: the empty words go around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a rant is a stream of hollow, ranting words

indicators.note: reciprocal suggests going back the other way, so the word aid is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses talk of mutual assistance as grand-sounding but hollow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reciprocal aid' reads as mutual help, but 'reciprocal' only signals reading the word backwards (DIA), which the hollow talk then wraps 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something radiant shines brightly and is glorious, just as splendid things dazzle.

clue.text: Upsetting study about English poverty

indicators.note: the reversed study goes around the English abbreviation
in a down clue, upsetting a word turns it upside down, so study's synonym is read bottom to top

parts.note: a den is a private study or retreat

explanation.surface: A disturbing piece of research on hardship in England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upsetting' turns DEN into NED, and 'about' wraps NED around E.
explanation.definitionFit: Need in this sense is want or destitution, a lack of the means to live.

clue.text: An extra book

definitions.meaning: a substitute player kept on the bench
to book is to arrange a seat or room in advance

explanation.definitionFit: A substitute held back for a team is a spare; booking a table means securing it ahead.

clue.text: Record a score, perhaps, of 2-6,6-4,3-6

definitions.meaning: to write down or note
in tennis these set scores leave a player one set behind overall

explanation.definitionFit: Putting something on paper is noting it; a tennis player losing two sets to one is a set behind.

clue.text: More than satisfied with a small tankard

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a mug is a drinking vessel like a tankard

explanation.surface: A drinker contentedly nursing a little beer mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-satisfied person is complacent, pleased with themselves beyond mere contentment.

clue.text: Foreign body hostile to army VIP

parts.note: anti means opposed to
GEN is the abbreviation for a general, a senior army officer

explanation.surface: An outsider in the ranks resents a top-ranking army officer.
explanation.definitionFit: In immunology a substance that triggers antibodies is an alien invader in the body.

clue.text: Great wealth, Lord, corrupted everyone in general

indicators.note: corrupted suggests something spoiled and changed, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A nobleman spoiled by riches, in a moral fable about money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrupted' tells you to rearrange the fifteen letters of GREAT WEALTH LORD.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means people generally, the public at large rather than any particular group.

clue.text: Change one's habits to make amends

definitions.meaning: playfully, to put on clothes again, habits being garments
to set right a wrong or compensate for it

explanation.definitionFit: Read as re-dress it means changing clothes; as one word it means remedying an injustice.

clue.text: Property-manager finds corrosion in a golfing area

indicators.note: the corrosion sits inside the golfing area

parts.note: the tee is the area from which a golfer drives off
rust is corrosion of iron

explanation.surface: An estate agent discovers a rusty patch on the golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A person holding assets on behalf of others administers that estate for them.

clue.text: Country from which I fled

parts.note: ran away means fled

explanation.surface: An exile's simple statement about the homeland they escaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation of the Middle East, formerly known as Persia.

clue.text: Youngsters sulk

definitions.meaning: a family of young birds or children
to mope and dwell resentfully

explanation.definitionFit: A hatch of chicks is a family of young; to mope sullenly is to dwell on grievances.

clue.text: A doughboy gains nothing from currency exchange

parts.note: doughboy is old American slang for an infantryman, a GI
O, the round figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: An American soldier abroad gets nothing back when swapping money.
explanation.definitionFit: An agio is the premium or fee charged when one money is changed into another.

clue.text: Money elicits the same expression of disgust

parts.note: DO is short for ditto, meaning the same again
ugh is an exclamation of revulsion

explanation.surface: Something provokes an identical cry of revulsion.
explanation.walkthrough: DO, short for ditto, is a crossword convention for 'the same'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dough is slang for cash, so it stands for money.

clue.text: Make improvements at noon

definitions.meaning: to correct or revise for the better
noon is the close of the morning period, so 'a.m. end'

explanation.definitionFit: To revise something is to better it; split, it reads as the end of the morning hours, which is midday.

clue.text: Assailed Sir Alec to make an impression

parts.note: hit means struck or assailed
Sir Alec Douglas-Home was a British Prime Minister in the 1960s

explanation.surface: A politician called Sir Alec was attacked, in an attempt to be noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Alec Douglas-Home was briefly British Prime Minister (1963-64).
explanation.definitionFit: A remark that strikes its target has its intended effect and registers strongly.

clue.text: Named minister involved in loan negotiation

indicators.note: the minister is wrapped up inside the other letters
negotiation implies working things over, so the letters of loan are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
MIN is an abbreviation for minister or ministry

explanation.surface: A government minister is identified as party to talks over a loan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Named minister' tempts a politician's name; 'negotiation' just rearranges the loan into NOAL, and 'involved in' sets the minister inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something existing in title only is named rather than real, as a nominal head.

clue.text: Seeks food over a long period

definitions.meaning: searches about for provisions
split as two words, it means for a very long time

explanation.definitionFit: Animals rummaging for something to eat are searching widely; split, the letters say 'for a very long time'.

clue.text: Funfair disrupted by a hoodlum

indicators.note: disrupted suggests throwing into disorder, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A thug spoils the fun at a travelling fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disrupted' asks for the letters of FUNFAIR rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A thug or brute is a violent, lawless person.

clue.text: Able to pay for a sun-roof?

definitions.meaning: having enough money to meet debts
sol is Latin for the sun and a vent is an opening, as in a roof

explanation.definitionFit: A business meeting its debts is in the black; whimsically, sol-vent is an opening for the sun.

clue.text: Plant article in a large country house

indicators.note: the article goes inside the country house

parts.note: a villa is a large country residence
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A grammatical article placed inside a stately home, of all things.
explanation.definitionFit: The vanilla orchid is a climbing plant whose pods give flavouring.

clue.text: Grape producer pockets bill as security against complaint

indicators.note: pockets means takes inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: grapes grow on a vine
ACC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A vineyard owner takes payment as insurance against grumbles.
explanation.definitionFit: An inoculation protects against disease, complaint being an old word for illness.

clue.text: Energetic Oxbridge lecturer was clearly a parasite

parts.note: live can mean lively or full of energy
a don is a university teacher, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A lively academic plainly sponged off others.
explanation.walkthrough: Oxbridge is the joint name for Oxford and Cambridge universities.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who existed by feeding off another depended on them as a host.

clue.text: Airmen need time to construct main platform

parts.note: the RAF is the Royal Air Force, made up of airmen

explanation.surface: Air Force men must take time to build a central stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' is a poetic word for the sea, so a 'main platform' floats on water.
explanation.definitionFit: A floating structure of logs or planks is a platform on the open sea.

clue.text: To use a plectrum requires courage

definitions.meaning: to pick at strings, as a guitarist does
nerve or bravery

explanation.definitionFit: Plucking is sounding a string with fingers or a pick; spirit in the face of danger is also called this.

clue.text: What criminals do for quick returns

indicators.note: returns suggests going back, so the synonym for quick is read backwards

parts.note: quick in its old sense means alive, as in the quick and the dead

explanation.surface: Lawbreakers' activity is done for fast profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quick' means alive (as in 'the quick and the dead'); 'returns' turns LIVE backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Wickedness is what wrongdoers commit, the noun naming wrongdoing itself.

clue.text: Confront a fellow expert

parts.note: an ace is a highly skilled person

explanation.surface: Stand up to a colleague who is a specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a problem head-on is to stand up to it.

clue.text: Certificate No 007

definitions.meaning: a document promising repayment of a loan
James ..., the fictional spy, has code number 007

explanation.definitionFit: A government security issued against a loan is a certificate; the spy with code 007 shares the name.

clue.text: Give inspiration to a friend from Islington

parts.note: N1 is the postcode of Islington in London, read as the letters N and I
mate is British slang for a friend

explanation.surface: Encourage a pal who lives in a north London district.
explanation.walkthrough: Islington is an area of north London whose postcode is N1, the digit 1 read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: To enliven someone is to breathe spirit into them.

clue.text: Tidy one after another

definitions.meaning: neat and properly arranged
in sequence

explanation.definitionFit: Things neatly arranged are orderly; items following one by one come in sequence.

clue.text: Wait assiduously to discover how many patronised the ballet

definitions.meaning: to fuss over and serve someone obsequiously

definitions.text: to discover how many patronised the ballet
definitions.meaning: read literally, a head count for a dance performance

explanation.definitionFit: To wait on someone fawningly is an idiom; read literally it is the audience figure at a dance show.
